packageTiers.buyerBehaviour: 65–70% choose the middle tier. Top tier anchors perception and makes middle feel safe. Bottom tier prevents sticker shock and qualifies budget-constrained buyers.

financeOption.positioning: Position as a tool for CFOs to preserve cash flow — 'align the investment with the asset depreciation schedule'
financeOption.triggerPoint: Offer finance when a client signals budget concern — before they walk away, not after

legitimate: Lead times: standard 4–6 weeks, custom 8–14 weeks — every week of delay adds to project timeline
Installation slots: installers book 4–6 weeks ahead — communicate booking window
Price validity: quote valid for 30 days — materials costs can fluctuate
Building access windows: if delivery must happen before lease expiry, there is a hard deadline
urgencyTriggers.neverManufacture: Never create artificial urgency — it destroys trust and positions TCD as a pressure seller
